item.title: Port St. Lucie teen named Southeast Youth of the Year surprised with World Cup trip
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, a Port St. Lucie teenager and Southeast Region Youth of the Year for Boys & Girls Clubs of America, will serve as a flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals.

item.title: DEA seizes 120 pounds of meth in Palm Beach County, warns surge spreading to Treasure Coast
item.description: Federal agents seized about 54 kilos of methamphetamine, nearly 120 pounds, in Palm Beach County in just two days. DEA agents warn the surge is beginning to spread to the Treasure Coast.

item.title: Port St. Lucie ranked 67th most stressed city in US, 42nd most financially stressed
item.description: Port St. Lucie ranked as the 67th most stressed city in the United States and 42nd most financially stressed, according to a new WalletHub study that compared 182 cities across 39 metrics.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals July 19
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, a Port St. Lucie teenager named Youth of the Year for the Southeast Region of the Boys & Girls Clubs of America, will serve as an official Coca-Cola flag bearer at the FIFA World Cup finals.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb to the top offers panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean and the Jupiter Inlet.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna, Shakira join World Cup final halftime show
item.description: Justin Bieber will join headliners Madonna, Shakira and BTS for the World Cup's star-studded halftime show at the final outside New York on July 19.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff at Wimbledon in dramatic tiebreaker semifinal
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.
